cause: The preceding toy MCP check populated the normal fallback tokenizer directory. verify_beta_mcp intentionally requires that directory absent to prove the generated configuration uses its warmed cache without a download.
classification: qualification harness ordering/precondition; not a launcher, model, or MCP search failure
resolution: Preserved the fallback cache outside the app and reused the successful first own-repository index for two new guarded MCP/interactive sessions. No shipping code or archive bytes changed.
